description: Paris City Flat is a beautiful bright apartment of 50 M² F3 in a 1920’s beautiful building typically Parisian, located in the heart of the City of Lights in a very quiet street.Ideally located in the 2nd district of Paris, Paris City Flat is the perfect choice for travelers who are interested both in architecture and monuments or even in shopping ; and who can discover all the cultural treasures that the French capital has to offer.The spaceOur establishment is unmatched thanks to its location in the heart of Paris, close to all amenities.Cleanliness of the flat, its location and the ease of access by public transport are part of what make the Paris City Flat experience nonesuch!What make us very spécial : the care we take our customers ! Indeed, the satisfaction of our customers is at the heart of our concerns. That's why we take great care to be attentive to their needs.Guest accessOn the first floor, with private elevator, the flat consists of 3 rooms: two separate bedrooms (1 master bedroom with an extra-large double bed and 1 bedroom with two bunk beds), a large living room, a fully equipped american kitchen, a beautiful bathroom and separate toilets.Altogether, it can accomodate up to 8 beds: 2 beds per room and 4 beds can fit in the living room thanks to two sofa beds and 2 folding beds. For families with young children a cot is available.Facilities include a flat-screen TV, safe, washing machine, tumble dryer, dishwasher, bar and free WiFi. Linen, sheets as well as towels are provided.Other things to noteFor the well-being of everyone, the flat is entirely non-smoking, and pets are not allowed.
